item.title: Where government goes, cities thrive
item.description: When government locates itself within an already active centre, it reinforces permanence, stability, and confidence. It deepens footfall, supports safety, and gives long-term purpose to existing investment.

item.title: Global chemical giant BASF expands Durban facility to boost regional supply

item.title: Catalytic projects in Durban: Dube TradePort SEZ (2026 update)
item.description: Dube TradePort Special Economic Zone (SEZ) is a premier investment location. It offers fully serviced industrial precincts adjacent to the King Shaka International Airport and provides opportunities for private sector investors seeking access to markets, efficiencies and seeking a safe and convenient location to serve the African continent.

item.title: Catalytic projects in Durban: Whetstone Business Park (2026 update)
item.description: Whetstone Business Park is an estate with commercial, retail and light industrial opportunities, strategically located 2 km from King Shaka International Airport in Durban, South Africa.
